title: Cassandra TimeUUID
summary: Cassandra's timeuuid is a UUID v1 (time-based) with a specific layout: the timestamp is in 100-nanosecond intervals since the Unix epoch (not the UUID epoch). The clock sequence and node ID are random. TimeUUIDs are sortable by time and used as clustering keys in Cassandra.

notes: Time-based UUID with Unix epoch (not UUID epoch).
Clock sequence and node ID are random (not MAC-based).
Sortable by time (unlike standard UUIDv1 which uses UUID epoch).
Used as clustering keys in Cassandra for time-series data.
